limitations_and_boundaries: Analysis is difficult if the cell types cannot be clearly distinguished from each other, or if in the course of experimentation the cells enter into new pathways of differentiation.
The forces controlling directed movements must overcome those of cell adhesion.
The molecular bonds involved in early, temporary and indiscriminate cell adhesions are extremely labile and not comparable to the bonds involved in antigen-antibody reactions.
